welcome the news: The whole village was happy to welcome the news that a new hospital would be built nearby.
全村的人都很高興，樂見附近將蓋一間新醫院的消息。
welcome a change: After ten years of doing the same job, I would really welcome a change in my daily routine.
做同樣的工作十年後，我真的會歡迎日常生活有所改變。
welcome feedback: Our teacher says she will always welcome feedback from students, because it helps her improve her lessons.
我們老師說她永遠歡迎學生的回饋，因為這能幫助她改進課程。
welcome with open arms: When the exchange student arrived in Taiwan, her host family welcomed her with open arms and a big dinner.
那位交換學生抵達台灣時，她的寄宿家庭張開雙臂歡迎她，還準備了一頓豐盛的晚餐。
you're welcome to: If you need a quiet place to study, you're welcome to use my room while I am away.
如果你需要安靜的地方讀書，我不在的時候歡迎你使用我的房間。
outstay one's welcome: We left the party before ten o'clock because we did not want to outstay our welcome at their home.
我們十點前就離開派對，因為不想在他們家待太久惹人嫌。
whip up support: The young leader traveled from town to town, giving speeches to whip up support for the new environmental law.
這位年輕領袖走訪一個又一個城鎮發表演說，煽動民眾支持新的環保法。
whip up a meal: My mom can whip up a meal in fifteen minutes with just some eggs, rice, and vegetables from the fridge.
我媽只用冰箱裡的一些蛋、米飯和蔬菜，十五分鐘內就能快速做好一餐。
whip into shape: The new coach promised to whip the lazy team into shape before the national competition next spring.
新教練承諾要在明年春天的全國比賽前，把這支懶散的隊伍整頓好。
whip up enthusiasm: The host told jokes and played loud music to whip up enthusiasm among the tired crowd before the concert.
演唱會開始前，主持人講笑話又播大聲的音樂，想激起疲憊觀眾的熱情。
whip out a phone: As soon as the famous singer walked in, every fan seemed to whip out a phone to take pictures.
那位知名歌手一走進來，每個粉絲似乎都迅速掏出手機拍照。
whip cream: To make the cake, you need to whip cream with sugar until it becomes thick, light, and fluffy.
做這個蛋糕時，你需要把鮮奶油加糖打發，直到它變得濃稠、輕盈又蓬鬆。
blow the whistle on: A brave worker decided to blow the whistle on the factory for secretly dumping waste into the river.
一位勇敢的員工決定揭發那家工廠偷偷把廢棄物倒進河裡。
whistle a tune: My grandfather likes to whistle a tune from his childhood while he waters the flowers in the garden.
我爺爺在花園澆花時，喜歡吹口哨哼一首他童年時的曲子。
whistle in the dark: He said he was not afraid of the exam at all, but I think he was just whistling in the dark.
他說他一點都不怕考試，但我覺得他只是在壯膽而已。
clean as a whistle: After two hours of hard work, the kitchen was as clean as a whistle, and Mom was very pleased.
努力打掃兩個小時後，廚房變得乾乾淨淨，媽媽非常滿意。
whistle-stop tour: The band went on a whistle-stop tour of ten cities in two weeks, staying only one night in each place.
這個樂團兩週內在十個城市進行快閃巡迴，每個地方只待一晚。
widen the gap: Experts worry that rising housing prices will widen the gap between the rich and the poor in big cities.
專家擔心房價上漲會擴大大城市裡貧富之間的差距。
widen one's horizons: Studying abroad for a year helped me widen my horizons and understand people from many different cultures.
出國留學一年幫助我開拓眼界，也讓我了解來自許多不同文化的人。
widen the road: The city plans to widen the road from two lanes to four to reduce the heavy traffic jams.
市政府計畫把這條道路從兩線道拓寬成四線道，以減少嚴重的塞車。
eyes widened: When she opened the box and saw the puppy inside, her eyes widened with surprise and joy.
她打開盒子看到裡面的小狗時，驚喜得眼睛睜大了。
widen the search: When the missing boy was not found in the park, the police decided to widen the search to the nearby hills.
在公園裡找不到失蹤的男孩後，警方決定擴大搜索範圍到附近的山丘。
widen access: The government wants to widen access to free online courses so that students in poor areas can learn too.
政府希望擴大免費線上課程的使用機會，讓偏鄉的學生也能學習。
wield power: In the past, kings could wield power over everyone in the country, and nobody dared to say no.
過去國王可以掌握權力支配國內每一個人，沒有人敢說不。
wield influence: Popular online stars can wield influence over what millions of teenagers buy, wear, and believe.
受歡迎的網紅能對數百萬青少年買什麼、穿什麼和相信什麼發揮影響力。
wield a weapon: In the movie, the hero learns to wield a weapon like a sword so he can protect his village.
在電影裡，主角學會揮舞像劍這樣的武器，好保護他的村莊。
wield authority: A good principal knows how to wield authority fairly without making teachers and students feel afraid.
好的校長懂得公平地行使權威，而不會讓老師和學生感到害怕。
wield a pen: Although he is ninety years old, he can still wield a pen well and writes a new poem every week.
雖然他已九十歲，仍然能好好執筆，每週寫一首新詩。
